instruction: Disable the option in VLC that limits it to one instance when opened from the file manager.

parameters.window_name: lecture.pdf — 6.006 Introduction to Algorithms, Lecture 2: Data Structures

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened VLC Tools > Preferences, navigated to Hotkeys tab, searched for 'play', switched to Advanced Preferences, but repeatedly failed to double-click the correct Global column cell for Play/Pause hotkey. Spent all 50 turns unable to set the global hotkey due to imprecise UI clicking.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VLC menus, navigate Preferences tabs (Interface, Hotkeys, Advanced), use search in hotkey list, type text, switch between Simple and All settings views
metadata.failure_analysis: Model could not precisely target the 'Global' column cell for 'Play/Pause' in the hotkey table. Kept clicking on 'Exit fullscreen' row instead. The hotkey table cells are small and hard to target accurately.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to unchecking a checkbox in VLC's Interface Settings. The 'one instance from file manager' checkbox is visible in the Playlist and Instances section, which the model can navigate to.
metadata.explanation: Task requires unchecking 'Use only one instance when started from file manager' in VLC Interface preferences. Evaluator reads vlcrc and checks one-instance-when-started-from-file setting equals 0.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'vlc_config' correctly reads ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc which contains the one-instance-when-started-from-file setting
Metric 'check_one_instance_when_started_from_file' correctly searches for 'one-instance-when-started-from-file=' in the config file and compares the value to the expected '0' (disabled)
Expected value 0 correctly represents the disabled state, matching the instruction to 'disable' the option
Default value of '1' in the metric handles the case where the key is not found in the config (meaning it's still enabled by default)
Postconfig correctly kills VLC before reading config, ensuring VLC saves its configuration to disk
Parameter handling is correct: expected.type='rule' so get_rule returns the rules dict directly, and the metric accesses rule['expected_one_instance_when_started_from_file'] correctly
Complete coverage: the instruction has a single requirement (disable one setting) and the evaluator checks exactly that
